entities.name: Charles Russell, Baron Russell of Killowen

entities.summary: Charles Arthur Russell, Baron Russell of Killowen, was an Irish statesman of the 19th century, and Lord Chief Justice of England. He was the first Roman Catholic to serve as Lord Chief Justice since the Reformation.
